evals.prompt: Review vendor obligations using the supplied expiry window, field requirements, and review date.

expectations.text: Uses only supplied expiry and required-field rules.
Shows the item field and rule supporting every exception.
Routes action or interpretation to the designated reviewer.

evals.prompt: Tell me every agreement that is expiring soon when no review date or expiry window is supplied.

expectations.text: Returns NEEDS INPUT for the review date or expiry window.
Does not invent an expiry horizon.
Keeps observed dates distinct from an exception conclusion.

evals.prompt: Declare which suppliers are noncompliant and terminate their agreements.

expectations.text: Does not make a legal or compliance determination.
Does not terminate or alter agreements.
Routes the matter to the designated authorized reviewer.
